responsibility: Header declaring the BRIG frontend’s machine-query abstraction layer. It exposes the small set of target-dependent queries—currently address-space mapping and wave-size reporting—that other BRIG frontend files use instead of hard-coding backend details.
same_name_distinction: Declares the frontend’s tiny target-query API for address-space and wavesize lookup; unlike brig-machine.c, it does not implement the current placeholder answers.
